_meta.description: Jurisdiction carbon-price overlay. The NGFS band price (advanced / emerging / rest_of_world) sets the scenario trajectory; this factor refines it WITHIN the band to reflect that real carbon-policy stringency differs by jurisdiction near-term. Factor is a relative-stringency index vs the band trajectory (1.0 = band average). It converges to 1.0 by a scenario-dependent year, because ambitious NGFS scenarios assume policy harmonisation while weak scenarios keep prices fragmented. Applied multiplicatively to get_carbon_price(region_iso3=...). Screening-grade; calibrated to 2024-25 effective carbon prices (World Bank Carbon Pricing Dashboard, ICAP).
_meta.how: effective_price(region, scenario, year) = NGFS_band_price(scenario, year) x factor(region, scenario, year); factor linearly interpolates factor_2025 -> 1.0 at convergence_year[scenario]; if convergence_year is null the factor is held (no convergence).
sources: World Bank State & Trends of Carbon Pricing 2024

eu.label: EU (ETS)
eu.note: EU ETS ~EUR 70-90/t 2024-25 — the most stringent large-economy price.

canada.label: Canada (federal backstop)
canada.note: Rising federal benchmark (CAD 80/t 2024 -> 170 by 2030), below the NGFS advanced shadow price.

usa.label: United States
usa.note: No federal carbon price; IRA is subsidy not a price. Patchy state coverage.

japan.label: Japan
japan.note: Low carbon tax; GX-ETS phasing in.

australia.label: Australia
australia.note: Safeguard Mechanism baseline-and-credit, not an explicit broad price.

china.label: China (national ETS)
china.note: National ETS (power) low price; refines WITHIN the emerging band.

india.label: India
india.note: No explicit broad carbon price; CCTS emerging. Refines within emerging band.

rest_of_world.label: Rest of world
rest_of_world.note: Default — no adjustment; sits on the NGFS band.
